Dear Jeffrey,
I've recently been in touch with Peggy Siegal. who has kindly agreed to forward this letter on my
behalf. I am Joana Vicente, Executive Director of the IFP. This year IFP celebrates the 21"
anniversary of the Gotham Independent Film Awards, and we have been fortunate enough to include
Peggy on our Advisory Committee for the last two years.
The Gotham Awards are the first honors of the film awards season and the premiere fundraiser for
the IFP, supporting our numerous programs all year-long. I would love to invite you to attend this
year's ceremony and have included a formal invitation with more information. As per Peggy's
suggestion, we would request a tax-deductible donation of $6000 to help underwrite the cost of the
event. I've included a S0lc3 form displaying our tax-exempt status for your reference.
The 201 1 Gotham Awards will take place the evening of November 28 at Cipriani Wall Street in
Downtown Manhattan and will be hosted by Edie Falco and Oliver Platt. We are thrilled to be
honoring David Cronenberg, Charlize Theron. Gary Oldman, and Fox's Tom Rothman, all of whom
will be in attendance. In addition, we have a number of exciting nominees, including Terrence
Malick's The Tree of Life, Alexander Payne's The Descendants. Kelly Reichardt's Meek's Cutoff as well
as the casts of Margin Call. Beginners, and Martha, Marcy, May, Marlene, among others. Man of the
actors of these films will be in attendance, as well as talents such as Tilda Swinton and
The Gotham Independent Film Awards honors the filmmaking community, expands the audience for
independent films, and supports the work that IFP does behind the scenes throughout the year to
bring such films to fruition. To give you a better idea about the IFP, we are the nation's oldest and
largest not-for-profit advocacy organization for independent filmmakers. We have supported 7,000
films and offered resources to more than 20,000 filmmakers since our inception in 1979. We have
championed the early work of pioneering independent filmmakers such as Charles Burnett. Todd
Haynes. Mira Nair. Michael Moore, Joel and Ethan Coen. Kevin Smith. and Todd Solondz. Through
our workshops, seminars, conferences. mentorships. and Filmmaker Magazine, we school our
members in the art, technology, and business of independent filmmaking.
I hope that you will join us at the Gotham Awards for what will surely be a wonderful evening in
celebration of independent film. Your contribution would mean so much to me and the organization.
Best.

Joana Vicente
Executive Director, IFP
